Origin and meaning

Jessica is a Hebrew name meaning “to behold (from Shakespeare)”.

About the name Jessica

Invented by Shakespeare for a character in The Merchant of Venice.

As a gift or a tattoo

Because it means “to behold (from Shakespeare)”, a Jessica calligraphy print makes a thoughtful gift for someone who loves the name or its meaning.
